description: This file defines a test case class 'Pseudo' for self-testing 'pseudo' functionality within the OEQA (OpenEmbedded Quality Assurance) framework. It includes a test method 'test_pseudo_pyc_creation' that manages configuration, cleans up '__pycache__' directories, runs a bitbake command, and verifies the presence or absence of specific '.pyc' files to validate behavior.

classes.name: Pseudo
classes.description: A test case class inheriting from OESelftestTestCase to perform self-tests related to pseudo functionality in the build system.

methods.name: test_pseudo_pyc_creation(self)
methods.description: Executes a sequence of steps to validate whether 'pseudo' Python compiled files are correctly created or omitted outside of the pseudo context.
